written.headline: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 per share, valuing company at $1.5 trillion
written.summary: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, raising $81 billion in proceeds and reaching a $1.5 trillion valuation on a fully diluted basis. The offering surpassed SpaceX's previous record to become the largest IPO in history by proceeds raised.

written.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
written.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a midtier model designed for software engineering, science, and knowledge work. Independent evaluations rank the model third overall on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index with a score of 61.

written.headline: Alibaba used regional companies to access Nvidia chips and aid military-linked lab
written.summary: Alibaba used its AI computing technology to aid a lab linked to China's military by accessing Nvidia chips via regional companies like Megaspeed. Indonesian police raided Megaspeed's local unit in early 2026 at the request of U.S. authorities over suspicions of helping Chinese entities obtain restricted hardware.

written.headline: Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package compromised with credential stealer
written.summary: Hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework Python package on PyPI on November 17, 2026, publishing two malicious versions designed to steal cloud credentials and sensitive developer information. The affected package averages roughly 190,000 to 200,000 monthly downloads.

written.headline: Coalition challenges Anthropic's safety branding ahead of IPO
written.summary: Ahead of Anthropic's initial public offering, a coalition of scientists, legal scholars, and tech leaders signed the MisAnthropic Statement challenging the company's safety branding. Prominent signatories include Steven Pinker, Oliver Hart, and Judea Pearl.

written.headline: Elon Musk criticizes Nvidia board for ousting Jensen Huang
written.summary: Elon Musk and other tech leaders discussed Nvidia's decision to remove former CEO Jensen Huang at the New York Times DealBook Summit. Musk compared the ousting to removing Michael Jordan from a winning team, while Nvidia's board confirmed it has no plans to reinstate Huang.

written.headline: OpenAI measures coding agents in research acceleration and recursive self-improvement
written.summary: OpenAI measured how coding agents accelerate AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

written.headline: OpenAI models applied to Jalapeño silicon and RISC-V core design
written.summary: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC-V core designs, demonstrating progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT-6 Astra.

written.headline: Study examines prompt injection protection in image-rendered documents
written.summary: Researchers evaluated how multimodal language models handle indirect prompt injection when documents are rendered as page images instead of plain text. They found that rendering reduces attack execution across models, but certain models still execute image-borne replacement at rates up to 77.96%.
